contract: G36 public failure line = <APP_PREFIX>=<one compact JSON object> followed by CR LF. Every byte before CR LF is 0x20-0x7E. After the app builds its JSON, every UTF-16 code unit above U+007F is written as backslash-u plus 4 lowercase hex digits (surrogate pairs unit by unit). Field names, field order and all other escapes stay exactly as the app producer makes them.
checks: identical bytes when written to a 949 console and to a 65001 console
JSON-decoding the escaped string gives the original text exactly
note_engine: PS5.1 ConvertTo-Json escapes the four characters < > & ' (as backslash-u003c, -u003e, -u0026, -u0027) and PS7 does not. The vectors avoid those four; both forms are valid JSON with the same meaning.
